title: Remove Launch real-media helper flat aliases
summary: Removed six internal Launch real-media helper aliases from the transitional flat window surface while preserving smoke-required evidence hooks and namespace exports.
reason: Continue namespace-first WebView cleanup in a Launch-owned touched domain without changing backend mutation, media policy, source handling, or pending-publish behavior.
behavior_before: Launch real-media worksheet row/match helpers, policy-alignment payload/rows, and sample-validation row/match helpers were available both through window.mediaPipelineLaunchView and direct flat window aliases.
behavior_after: Those six internal helpers are asserted through window.mediaPipelineLaunchView only. Evidence hooks required by browser smokes remain flat exports.
tests_added: Extended Local API WebView static coverage to assert namespace availability and absence of the removed Launch real-media helper flat aliases.
Updated WebView real-media smoke text expectations to the current save-candidate/read-only Settings policy-delta wording exposed during validation.
rollback_plan: Restore the six Launch real-media helper flat assignments, restore the inventory/current-state counts to 687 and launchView.js to 39, restore the previous smoke expectations if the product copy is reverted, regenerate the WebView contract baseline and summaries, then rerun the same WebView validation ladder.
